name: Come Just As You Are
overview: The Scriptures reveal a gracious invitation from Christ to all who are burdened and spiritually broken, assuring them rest and salvation. The Lord draws near to those with a contrite heart and calls sinners to repentance, emphasizing that He came to seek and save the lost. Jesus promises that everyone who comes to Him will not be rejected, and that belief in Him grants everlasting life and resurrection on the last day.
